lubricant.name: Krytox LVP (PFPE grease)
lubricant.use: a film wiped on with a lint-free swab; holds face rings in grooves that face down when closed

verification: D405 RGB at 70-120 mm before each closure: ring present, unbroken, in the groove all round, no twist mark (about 0.1-0.15 mm per pixel at 100 mm, 87 deg x 58 deg); its depth (+-2 % at 50 cm, roughly +-1.4 % at 20 cm) is too coarse to see a 0.5-0.9 mm proud cord, so seating is checked by force

force signature in UR force mode (F/T +-100 N range, +-5.5 N accuracy): the roller's 10-20 N press stays flat round the groove (a dip is a gap, a spike an overlap); rod and spigot insertions follow a reference curve (double peak = pinched ring)
leak test after assembly: rate of rise from <= 1 mbar and O2 drift at +20 mbar argon (seals.md), plus a helium sniff of each new joint if the rate of rise fails

forces.what: Ø6 m6 dowel and diamond pin pressed 10 mm into the 6061 floor (H7)
forces.basis: Lame press fit, 0.008 mm diametral interference, mu 0.15: p = 58 MPa
forces.robot: NO: 16x the F/T range; a UR pushing this hard is past its force limit. Arbor press by a person, or a slip fit (g6) with retaining compound so the robot only inserts it

forces.what: spigot's 2-238 entering the Ø96 floor port
forces.basis: Parker 5.11.2: fc 2.07 lb/in at 22.1 % over pi x 96 mm; break-out 3x
forces.robot: robot starts it on the lead-in chamfer (<= 50 N in force mode), the two captive M6 screws pull it home

forces.what: hollow rod through the two 2-114 rod O-rings
forces.basis: Parker 5.11.2: fc 1.99 lb/in at 21.3 % over pi x 15.875 mm, two rings
forces.robot: yes in force mode with a PFPE film (lubricated, about half); dry break-out is at the F/T range

forces.what: build plate into the honed bore (0.15 mm radial clearance) and onto the bayonet
forces.basis: sliding fit; 10 N contact for a spiral search
forces.robot: yes: force-guided spiral search; positioning alone (AprilTag + D405, about +-0.4 mm) is coarser than the clearance

forces.what: drawer against its 2-033 (358 N to squeeze, seals.md)
forces.basis: the two quarter-turn latches pull it the last 0.4 mm
forces.robot: robot pushes to first contact only

forces.what: reservoir onto the dock O-ring along its 2 deg ramps (seals.md)
forces.basis: seals.md: 94 N push home, 58 N pull-out
forces.robot: yes, but at the F/T range's edge (100 N): set the push to 94 N +- 5.5 N

forces.what: door draw latches, 725 N preload each (seals.md)
forces.robot: NO: a person closes them (or pneumatic clamps, seals.md (b))

forces.what: M3 / M4 / M5 / M6 A2-70 in A2 inserts, mu 0.14 (MoS2 paste)
forces.basis: Pfeiffer Vacuum's A2-70 table (90 % of Rp0.2): M4 2.2, M5 4.2, M6 7.4 N m at mu 0.14; M3 from TR Fastenings
forces.robot: OnRobot Screwdriver 0.15-5 N m covers M3-M5; M6 needs the inline nutrunner (1.5-10 N m)

forces.basis: Bollhoff HELICOIL power tools E-S 206 (0.45-0.95 N m), E-PSG (0.9-3 N m)
forces.robot: machine shop, with the tang broken off

tipover.case: chamber body on the vacuum gripper (7.3 kg + 0.8 kg)
12.5 kg at 1300 mm (rated payload at full reach)
reservoir push home 94 N, sideways at 1.25 m
dowel press 1.6 kN (if a robot tried)
